• Ein wunderschönes, zentrales und hundefreundliches Büro mit inspirierenden Räumen, sonniger Terrasse und gutem Essen – ein Ort, der verbindet und Kraft gibt
• Exklusive Team-Benefits: 40 % Rabatt auf die Westwing Collection, 20 % auf Drittmarken, 10 % Family-&-Friends-Rabatt und Gutscheine zu besonderen Anlässen
• Wellbeing-Support mit Mental-Health-Ressourcen, Sportangeboten und Vorsorgeprogrammen
• Nachhaltige Mobilität mit JobRad und ÖPNV-Vorteilen – für ein bewusstes und umweltfreundliches Unterwegssein
• Unterstützung für Eltern mit unserer eigenen Westwing Wichtel-Kita und einer Partnerschaft mit Elly & Stoffl
• Ein jährlicher Social Impact Day, an dem du dich für ein Herzensprojekt engagieren kannst – weil Menschlichkeit unsere Stärke ist
• Teamrituale, die Erfolge feiern und verbinden – von Sommer- und Winterfesten bis hin zum Oktoberfest


ABOUT US

Westwing, Europas #1 im Beautiful Living E-Commerce, ist in 20+ europäischen Ländern vertreten und hat im Jahr 2025 ein GMV (Bruttowarenvolumen) von EUR 507 Mio. erwirtschaftet. Als Europas Premium One-Stop Destination für Designliebhaber bietet Westwing ein einzigartiges Markenerlebnis mit einem kuratierten Sortiment aus der Westwing Collection und Drittmarken. Die integrierte Plattform vereint Shop, Daily Specials, Stores, B2B Services (Westwing Business) und den Westwing Design Service. Westwings Team arbeitet zusammen an dem gemeinsamen Ziel ""Excite people to create homes that unlock the full beauty of life"". Westwing wurde 2011 gegründet, hat seinen Hauptsitz in München und ist seit Oktober 2018 an der Frankfurter Börse gelistet.

Als leistungsorientiertes Team arbeiten wir in einem schnellen, inspirierenden, internationalen und informellen Umfeld zusammen, das dir ermöglicht, deine Karriere voranzutreiben und mit einer Marke und Produkten zu arbeiten, die unsere Kunden lieben. Bewirb dich jetzt und werde Teil von #teamwestwing!

description_html:
Your way into the future

Shape the Future of Global Connectivity
At Mynaric, we're building the optical fiber for the skies.
As a pioneer in laser communications, we develop cutting-edge technology that enables ultra-fast, secure, and reliable data transmission between satellites, aircraft, drones, and terrestrial platforms. Our solutions are helping shape the future of aerospace, defense, and global communications networks.
We are looking for an ambitious and commercially driven Senior Sales & Business Development Manager, Asia-Pacific to accelerate our growth across one of the world's most dynamic aerospace and defense markets.
This is more than a sales role.
You will be the driving force behind expanding Mynaric's presence across Asia-Pacific, developing strategic customer relationships, identifying major business opportunities, and transforming qualified prospects into long-term partnerships. You will engage directly with senior executives, government stakeholders, defense organizations, system integrators, and innovative commercial space companies that are shaping the future of connectivity.
Just as importantly, you will remain actively involved after contract award, working closely with our Customer Project Manager and Project Leads to ensure customer expectations, program execution, and business objectives remain aligned throughout the customer journey.
If you are energized by complex sales cycles, strategic customer engagement, international business growth, and working at the intersection of cutting-edge technology and mission-critical programs, this role offers a unique opportunity to make a lasting impact.


What awaits you at Mynaric

Drive Growth Across Asia-Pacific
You will be responsible for identifying, developing, and securing new business opportunities across government, defense, aerospace, satellite, and commercial markets throughout the region.
By building a deep understanding of customer priorities, market trends, and competitive landscapes, you will position Mynaric's solutions to solve critical challenges and create long-term value for our customers.

Build Trusted Customer Relationships
You will develop strong relationships with key decision-makers, program leaders, procurement organizations, engineers, and executive stakeholders.
Acting as a trusted advisor, you will help customers understand how Mynaric's technology can support their strategic and operational objectives while creating opportunities for sustainable business growth.

Partner with Customers Throughout the Entire Lifecycle
Unlike traditional sales roles, your involvement does not end at contract signature.
You will work closely with the Customer Project Manager and Project Leads to support successful program execution, facilitate customer communications, participate in program reviews, and ensure alignment between contractual commitments, delivery milestones, and customer expectations.
Your ability to maintain trust during execution will be critical in driving customer satisfaction, repeat business, and long-term partnerships.

Lead Complex Sales and Capture Activities
You will own opportunities from initial market engagement through qualification, proposal development, negotiation, contract award, and expansion.
Working alongside Sales Engineering, Engineering, Product Management, Program Management, and Executive Leadership, you will develop winning strategies that differentiate Mynaric and maximize customer value.

Influence the Future of Our Business
As the voice of the customer within Mynaric, you will bring market insights, competitive intelligence, and customer feedback back into the organization to shape product development, strategic decision-making, and future growth initiatives.


What you bring with you

Experience

  • 8+ years of experience in sales, business development, strategic account management, or capture management within the aerospace, defense, satellite, communications, or high-technology sectors.
  • Experience developing business within Asia-Pacific markets and navigating complex customer and government environments.
  • Proven success leading multi-stakeholder sales campaigns from opportunity identification through contract award.
  • Strong commercial acumen and track record of delivering measurable business growth.
Leadership & Collaboration
  • Ability to influence and engage stakeholders at all levels, from engineers and program managers to C-level executives and government decision-makers.
  • Experience working successfully in a matrix organization with cross-functional teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate closely with project delivery teams while maintaining a strong customer focus.
  • Natural relationship builder who thrives on creating trust, alignment, and long-term partnerships.
Personal Attributes
  • Strategic thinker with a growth mindset and strong commercial instincts.
  • Customer-centric and passionate about solving complex challenges.
  • Confident communicator and presenter with excellent negotiation skills.
  • Self-motivated, resilient, and comfortable operating in a fast-moving international environment.
  • Collaborative team player who enjoys working across functions and cultures.
Education & Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Aerospace, Telecommunications, Business, or a related discipline.
  • MBA or equivalent advanced business qualification is an advantage.
  • Experience with CRM and pipeline management tools.
  • Fluent English is essential; additional Asia-Pacific languages are highly desirable.
  • Willingness to travel internationally up to 50% of working time.


What we offer you

Be part of the company that is changing the world!
Have you always wanted to come to work in your favorite space outfit? Then you are exactly right with us! Forget bureaucracy and work together with inspiring colleagues from all over the world while you embark on an incredible journey with Mynaric to work on unique and challenging projects and make a real contribution to the future of connectivity.

We offer flexible working hours as well as time off in lieu, diverse areas of responsibility, and an attractive compensation package as well as additional benefits such as: a mobility budget (public transport ticket, business bike, fuel voucher), non-cash benefits in the form of a shopping voucher, and company events.

title: Project Director Schlüsselfertiger Wohnungsbau
salary_basis: Based on leadership compensation records at MKE Munich Investment GmbH
description_html:
Bis heute haben wir Immobilienprojekte im Gesamtvolumen von über einer 1 Milliarde Euro erfolgreich entwickelt und umgesetzt. Unser Fokus liegt auf der Entwicklung und Schaffung von bezahlbarem Wohnraum in Deutschland und Europa.

Wir denken nicht wie klassische Immobilienentwickler – sondern wie Unternehmer: mit industrieller Haltung, Effizienzfokus und klarer Verantwortung für das, was wir bauen. Unsere Projekte entstehen durch tiefes operatives Engagement, partnerschaftliche Zusammenarbeit und der Überzeugung, dass Schlichtheit, Kosteneffizienz und Qualität Hand in Hand gehen können.

„Anders gebaut, um anders zu bauen.“
Unsere Struktur ist bewusst anders gewählt: vertikal integriert, eigentümergeführt, mit direkter Umsetzung durch interne Teams.

Unser Ansatz

In einer Zeit, in der viele technologiebasierte Produkte immer leistungsfähiger, zuverlässiger und gleichzeitig kostengünstiger werden, ist der Wohnungsbau in Deutschland in seinen Grundstrukturen seit Jahrzehnten nahezu unverändert geblieben. Wir setzen uns zum Ziel, dieses Paradigma grundlegend zu verändern: Durch die Entwicklung eines standardisierten, hochgradig optimierten Ansatzes wollen wir die Baukosten drastisch senken und gleichzeitig die Qualität und Verlässlichkeit des Wohnraums deutlich erhöhen. Kombiniert mit der zunehmenden Nachfrage nach bezahlbarem Wohnraum, wird dieses neue Modell den Weg für eine effizientere, nachhaltigere und sozialere Stadtentwicklung ebnen.

Unser Unternehmen basiert auf der Überzeugung, dass Schlichtheit, Kosteneffizienz und Qualität Hand in Hand gehen können.
Durch die Eliminierung traditioneller, kostenintensiver Strukturen – sowohl intern in der Projektabwicklung als auch extern durch gezielte Einzelvergabe statt Generalunternehmermodelle – senken wir Kosten, beschleunigen Entscheidungsprozesse und erhöhen die Transparenz. Indem wir einen Großteil der Planungs- und Steuerungsleistungen intern abbilden, sichern wir nicht nur eine engere Qualitätskontrolle, sondern verkürzen auch die Rückkopplung zwischen Planung und Ausführung. Durch die konsequente Fokussierung auf einfache, bewährte Grundrisse, standardisierte Materialien und optimierte Bauprozesse schaffen wir robuste, hochwertige Produkte – effizient, zuverlässig und zukunftsfähig.

Aufgaben

Als Project Director übernehmen Sie die vollständige Verantwortung für die Realisierung unserer Wohnungsbauprojekte mit durchschnittlich rund 100 Wohneinheiten – vom ersten Konzept bis zur Schlüsselübergabe. Sie leiten das Projektteam, treffen Entscheidungen und stellen sicher, dass Qualität, Budget und Zeitplan nicht nur erreicht, sondern übertroffen werden.

  • Sicherstellen, dass unser Projektentwicklungshandbuch umgesetzt und eingehalten wird. Ihre Vorschläge und Ideen zur Verbesserung unseres etablierten Systems sind willkommen und ausdrücklich erwünscht.
  • Optimierung von Planungs- und Baukonzepten mit klarem Fokus auf Effizienz, Wirtschaftlichkeit und Geschwindigkeit.
  • Koordination und Kontrolle der am Projekt beteiligten Architektur- und Ingenieurteams während der Planungsphase und Sicherstellung, dass unser Projektentwicklungshandbuch eingehalten wird.
  • Führung von Verhandlungen und Ausarbeitung von Verträgen mit Partnern, Auftragnehmern und Dienstleistern, die an dem Projekt beteiligt sind auf Grundlage unseres Projektentwicklungshandbuchs.
  • Überwachung der einzelnen Projektteams bei der Umsetzung der Bauverträge und Kontrolle der ausführenden Unternehmen (Einzelvergabe der Bauleistungen an Nachunternehmer)
  • Koordination mit Behörden, Ingenieuren, Architekten, Nachunternehmer.

Qualifikation

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium (Architektur, Bauwesen, Ingenieurwesen) oder vergleichbare Erfahrung.
  • Hohe Leistungsfähigkeit, Durchsetzungsstärke, Unternehmergeist.
  • Außergewöhnliche Problemlösungskompetenz – mit klarem Fokus auf Einfachheit, Schnelligkeit und Umsetzbarkeit.
  • Fähigkeit, schnell zu lernen und Prioritäten richtig zu setzen, um den Anforderungen von Investoren und Unternehmen gerecht zu werden.
  • Unkonventionelles Denken und die Fähigkeit, etablierte Wege zu hinterfragen und mutig neue Methoden in der Wohnraumplanung und im Bauwesen auszuprobieren.
  • Ausgeprägtes unternehmerisches Denken, hohe Motivation und der starke Wunsch, zu lernen, zu wachsen und erfolgreich zu sein
  • Kostenbewusstsein ist für Sie keine Pflicht, sondern ein Wettbewerb – Sie lieben es, Projekte unterhalb des Budgets und vor Ablauf der Frist abzuschließen.
  • Kommunikationsstärke und Durchsetzungsvermögen
  • Fundierte Kenntnisse in MS Office, Excel, CAD und PDF.

Benefits

  • Mitarbeit an Projekten, die echten Mehrwert für die Gesellschaft schaffen und das Leben vieler Menschen verbessern – bezahlbarer Wohnraum ist unser Beitrag für die Zukunft.
  • Anerkennung als Game Changer am Immobilienmarkt – mit Kosteneinsparungen von über 30 % und bis zu 50 % kürzeren Bauzeiten im Vergleich zu traditionellen Marktteilnehmern.
  • Arbeiten in einem leistungsorientierten und dynamischen Umfeld mit flachen Hierarchien.
  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit den Eigentümern und Investoren – schnelle Entscheidungsprozesse und maximale Umsetzungskraft zeichnen unser Unternehmen aus.
  • Ein Unternehmen, in dem Ergebnisse zählen – Ihr Engagement wird geschätzt und belohnt.
  • Offene Kommunikation auf Augenhöhe.
  • Langfristige Anstellung mit der Möglichkeit, Anteilseigner und Partner zu werden.
  • Eine einzigartige Unternehmenskultur, die den Erfolg jedes Teammitglieds fördert, Unterstützung bietet und Ideen ernst nimmt.
  • Gezielte Investition in Ihr Wachstum: Neben persönlichem Mentoring durch einen unserer Investoren und Gründer bieten wir Ihnen Zugang zu hochwertigem Wissen – von Büchern über Konferenzen bis hin zu Fachkursen, sowie die Möglichkeit, an strategischen Meetings und Veranstaltungen teilzunehmen. Dieses Umfeld verschafft Ihnen langfristig entscheidende Vorteile.
  • Firmenwagen Ihrer Wahl.

Vergütung:

Ihre Vergütung (Festgehalt + sehr hohe leistungsabhängige Vergütung) wird individuell festgelegt und kann je nach folgenden Faktoren variieren: Motivation, berufsspezifische Kenntnisse und Fähigkeiten, Ausbildung und Erfahrung.

Ihr Leistungsbonus, der während des Projekts in mehreren Tranchen ausgezahlt wird, richtet sich nach Ihrer Leistung und der Erreichung Ihrer Ziele und liegt zwischen 12 und 36 Monatsgehältern pro Projekt.

Die leistungsbezogene Vergütung wird durch einen verbindlichen Vertrag mit sehr klaren Zielen/Prämien garantiert. Der Leistungsbonus wird während der Projektdauer in mehreren Stufen ausgezahlt. Zum Beispiel: Nach Erhalt der Baugenehmigung mit den verbesserten Parametern, nach Abschluss der Rohbauarbeiten innerhalb des Budgets und Zeitplans, nach erfolgreicher Fertigstellung.

description_html:
Zur Verstärkung unseres strategischen Teams suchen wir eine erfahrene Kommunikationsstrategin oder einen erfahrenen Kommunikationsstrategen (m/w/d) mit Fokus auf Gesamtstrategie.

Du entwickelst Kommunikations- und Kampagnenstrategien über alle Kanäle hinweg – von der Analyse der Ausgangslage über Positionierung und Kernbotschaften bis zum Maßnahmenplan. Du bist strategische Schnittstelle zwischen Kund:in, internem Team und Umsetzung und sorgst dafür, dass Strategie, Social Media, Kreation und Produktion zu einer konsistenten Gesamtkommunikation ineinandergreifen. Du machst aus Analysen belastbare Empfehlungen und bringst Menschen in Workshops zu konkreten Ergebnissen.

Aufgaben

Deine Aufgaben

  • Entwicklung von Kommunikations-, Marken- und Kampagnenstrategien über alle Kanäle hinweg
  • Analyse von Ausgangslagen, Zielgruppen, Märkten und Kanälen als Grundlage strategischer Empfehlungen
  • Konzeption, Vorbereitung und Moderation von Workshops und Befähigungsformaten – inklusive dokumentierter Ergebnisse
  • Übersetzung der Strategie in Umsetzung: Social Media, Kampagnen und Formate entlang klarer Ziele
  • Datenbasierte Steuerung: KPI-Definition, Reporting und Auswertung
  • Direkte Beratung von Kund:innen – im öffentlichen Dienst genauso wie in der Politik
  • Projektverantwortung von der Konzeption bis zum Ergebnis, auch in intensiven Projektphasen

Qualifikation

  • Mindestens 2 Jahre Agenturerfahrung – idealerweise in strategischer Kommunikation, Kampagne oder Beratung
  • Sichere Analyse- und Strukturierungsfähigkeit: komplexe Zusammenhänge erfassen, auf den Punkt bringen, in Empfehlungen übersetzen
  • Sicheres Auftreten vor der Gruppe: Workshops konzipieren, moderieren und zu Ergebnissen führen
  • Starkes Textgefühl und konzeptionelle Stärke
  • Eigenständige, strukturierte Arbeitsweise und Freude an einem Umfeld mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen
  • Politisches Interesse ist ein Plus, Parteibuch keine Voraussetzung
  • Erfahrung mit KI-Tools im Kommunikationsprozess ist von Vorteil

Benefits

  • Eine verantwortungsvolle Schlüsselrolle im strategischen Team mit sichtbarer Wirkung
  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit Kreation, Social Media und dem Videoproduktionsteam
  • Eigene Kundenprojekte, flexible Arbeitszeiten
  • Ein eingespieltes Team mit kurzen Wegen, klaren Erwartungen und Raum für eigene Ideen
  • Ein zentrales Office an der Kieler City, am Wasser

description_html:
Für unser neues Lackiertechnikum suchen wir ab sofort einen engagierten Techniker Fachrichtung Industrielle Beschichtungstechnik (m/w/d).

Aufgaben

  • Du betreust die neue Roboterlackieranlage in unserem Technikum
  • Du erstellst, testest und qualifizierst Lackierprogramme
  • Du bemusterst und qualifizierst neue Lacksysteme
  • Du wirkst aktiv bei der Weiterentwicklung unserer firmenweiten Lackiertechnik mit
  • Du schulst unsere Lackiererei-Mitarbeiter

Qualifikation

  • Du verfügst über eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung zum staatlich geprüften Techniker Fachrichtung Industrielle Beschichtungstechnik oder ähnlich
  • Du besitzt eine gute Auffassungsgabe
  • Du zeichnest dich durch eine strukturierte, effektive und selbstständige Arbeitsweise aus
  • Du kommunizierst gerne in deutscher und englischer Sprache
  • Du arbeitest gerne im Team, bist kommunikativ, bringst technisches Verständnis mit und lernst gerne dazu
  • Gelegentliche Reisen zu unseren ausländischen Standorten schrecken dich nicht ab

Benefits

  • Interessanter und vielfältiger Arbeitsplatz in einem zukunftsorientierten und wachsenden Familienunternehmen
  • Unbefristeter Arbeitsplatz
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten
  • Angenehmes Betriebsklima mit motivierten Kollegen, unternehmensweiter Du-Kultur und offener Kommunikation
  • Flache Hierarchie mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen
  • Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten
  • Wertschätzender Umgang
  • Kostenloser Kaffee und Wasserspender
  • Mitarbeiterevents (Sommerfest mit Familienangehörigen, Weihnachtsfeier)
  • Arbeitgebergestützte betriebliche Altersvorsorge über das gesetzliche Maß hinaus
  • Bikeleasing
  • Deutschlandticket Job

Haben wir dein Interesse geweckt?
Dann werde Teil unseres internationalen Teams und sende uns deine aussagekräftigen Bewerbungsunterlagen oder informiere dich unverbindlich vorab in einem persönlichen Gespräch.

description_html:
Hims & Hers is the leading health and wellness platform, on a mission to help the world feel great through the power of better health. About the Role:

The Global Tax team is expanding to support Hims & Hers' continued growth across EMEA. We are looking for an experienced, detail-oriented tax professional to serve as the tax lead for our EMEA region. The Tax Manager, EMEA will take ownership of all tax provision, compliance, and tax audit matters for the region, working closely with external advisors and local finance/accounting teams and partnering with the U.S.-based corporate tax team on cross-border tax matters. This role will report to the Senior Manager, International Tax.

Responsibilities:

  • Manage quarterly and annual tax provisions for the EMEA entities under U.S. GAAP and local statutory standards.

  • Ensure the timely and accurate preparation and submission of corporate income tax and indirect tax filings across multiple EMEA jurisdictions, working closely with accounting/finance teams and external tax advisors.

  • Assist with operational tax matters such as withholding taxes and tax registrations.

  • Support and manage tax audits, enquiries and correspondence with local tax authorities.

  • Partner closely with the U.S. tax team, as well as corporate legal and accounting teams, on complex initiatives including entity restructuring, transfer pricing documentation, and permanent establishment (PE) risks analysis.

  • Monitor legislative and regulatory developments across the region and assess business impact.

  • Partner with the global tax team to develop and implement tax-efficient structures for new business and existing operations in EMEA.

  • Effectively communicate status/issues to the Senior Manager, International Tax in the U.S. for all EMEA entities.

  • Perform general EMEA tax research to resolve issues and work with external advisers where needed to support business initiatives.

  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date tax compliance calendars and documentation, ensuring robust control and risk management.

  • Develop tax staff by managing performance, setting goals, providing ongoing training, and maintaining strong employee relationships.

Experience & Skills:

  • Bachelor's degree in accounting, finance, or tax required.

  • At least 5 years’ experience in corporate tax gained within a multinational organisation or Big 4/public accounting environment.

  • Professional qualification in Tax, Accounting, or Finance (e.g. ACA, ACCA) preferred.

  • Strong technical knowledge of EMEA direct and indirect tax rules, reporting obligations and tax accounting standards.

  • Experience with US GAAP tax provision preparation and review (ASC 740) preferred.

  • Familiarity with transfer pricing principles and international tax frameworks (e.g., BEPS, Pillar Two).

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to partner effectively with the U.S.-based tax team across time zones.

  • Detail-oriented and highly organized, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, growing environment.

We are committed to building a workforce that reflects diverse perspectives and prioritizes ethics, wellness, and a strong sense of belonging. If you're excited about this role, we encourage you to apply—even if you're not sure if your background or experience is a perfect match.

Hims considers all qualified applicants for employment, including applicants with arrest or conviction records, in accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, the California Fair Chance Act, and any similar state or local fair chance laws.

It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

title: Senior Revenue Enablement Manager, EMEA
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Vanta
description_html:
At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. 

As Vanta continues its push into new markets, the EMEA Revenue Org is at the center of that growth — and this role is the dedicated enablement partner making that motion faster, sharper, and more scalable. As a Sr. Revenue Enablement Manager supporting our EMEA organization, you'll operate as a true strategic thought partner to Sales and Post-sales leadership, helping design and build the enablement infrastructure needed to win in complex sales environments. This is a high-autonomy role that shapes how Vanta's revenue teams learn, grow, and perform.

This role will lead the execution of both global enablement initiatives and region-specific programs. You’ll work independently, build credibility with senior stakeholders, and help EMEA leaders reinforce new skills and behaviors with their teams.

What you’ll do as a Senior Revenue Enablement Manager at Vanta:

  • Partner closely with EMEA Revenue Leadership to understand business priorities, team performance, and enablement needs.

  • Build trusted relationships with sales leadership and cross-functional partners across Revenue and the broader business.

  • Diagnose gaps in industry, product, sales methodology, and role-specific skills across EMEA.

  • Design and prioritize a regional enablement roadmap that connects global initiatives to the needs of EMEA teams.

  • Support regional onboarding where needed.

  • Create and deliver enablement programs, content, workshops, and other learning experiences that improve sales execution.

  • Partner with EMEA leaders to reinforce enablement in the field and hold teams accountable for applying new knowledge and skills.

  • Measure program effectiveness, gather feedback, and refine enablement priorities as the business, product, and sales motion evolve.

  • Collaborate with other Revenue Enablement partners to maintain alignment across global programs and regional delivery.

How to be successful in this role:

  • 5+ years of experience in sales enablement, GTM enablement, or an equivalent role.

  • Experience supporting EMEA-specific sales teams and markets.

  • Experience supporting global sales organizations in a variety of roles spanning Early Stage through Upmarket segments.

  • A track record of designing and delivering sales methodology enablement.

  • Experience in SaaS; experience supporting a technical product is preferred.

  • Strong ability to diagnose capability gaps and translate them into focused enablement priorities.

  • Excellent communication, facilitation, and presentation skills across varied audiences.

  • Strong business partnership and cross-functional collaboration skills.

  • Ability to operate independently, manage ambiguity, and build credibility with senior sales leaders.

  • Uses AI in day-to-day work to amplify their skills and strengthen their outcomes, applying it across routine workflows, actively building fluency through experimentation, and exercising sound judgment to ensure AI-assisted work meets a high quality bar.

  • Open to using AI to amplify their skills and strengthen their work - demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact.

What you can expect as a Vanta’n:

  • Industry-competitive salary and equity

  • 100% covered medical, dental, and vision benefits with dependents coverage

  • 16 weeks paid Parental Leave for all new parents

  • Health & wellness stipend

  • Remote workspace, internet, and mobile phone stipend

  • Commuter benefits for team members who attend the office

  • Pension matching

  • 25 days of Annual Leave per year and unlimited sick time

  • 8 company-paid holidays

  • Virtual team building activities, lunch and learns, and other company-wide events!

  • Offices in SF, NYC, London, Dublin, Tel Aviv, and Sydney

#LI-hybrid

At Vanta, we are committed to hiring diverse talent of different backgrounds and as such, it is important to us to provide an inclusive work environment for all. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, gender identity, age, religion, sexual orientation, veteran or disability status, or any other protected class. As an equal opportunity employer, we encourage and welcome people of all backgrounds to apply.

About Vanta

We started in 2018, in the wake of several high-profile data breaches. Online security was only becoming more important, but we knew firsthand how hard it could be for fast-growing companies to invest the time and manpower it takes to build a solid security foundation. Vanta was inspired by a vision to restore trust in internet businesses by enabling companies to improve and prove their security. From our early days automating security monitoring for compliance standards like SOC 2, HIPAA and ISO 27001 to creating the world's leading Trust Management Platform, our vision remains unchanged. 

Now more than ever, making security continuous—not just a point-in-time check— is essential. Thousands of companies rely on Vanta to build, maintain and demonstrate their trust— all in a way that's real-time and transparent.

Referral Instructions

If you are being referred for the role, please contact that person to apply on your behalf.

description_html:
The Role

SalesAPE.ai is looking for a sharp, early-career Founder's Associate to sit at the operational core of the business. You'll own the systems, processes, and relationships that keep the company running — from people ops and onboarding to investor relations, equity schemes, and everyday firefighting. You'll be the person people come to when they don't know who else to ask, and you'll be expected to find the answer, not just point elsewhere.

This role sits within Operations, reporting to the General Manager/Chief of Staff, with regular direct exposure to the founder & CEO. This is a hybrid role, and we'd generally expect around three days a week in our London office, with flexibility on the rest. You'll be handed real ownership from day one across HR, finance-adjacent admin, legal coordination, and investor relations. This is a role for someone who wants breadth, responsibility, and a front-row seat to how a startup is actually built.

Key Responsibilities & Scope

  • Own People Ops & HR end-to-end: onboarding/offboarding, contracts, payroll coordination with finance, systems access, equipment, and all things Rippling

  • Administer core company workspaces and platforms, including Google Suite, Slack, etc.

  • Support investor relations and cap table management (SeedLegals, Carta), working with the Finance team, investors, and HMRC on related matters

  • Manage UK EMI and US ISO equity schemes, including issuance and ongoing cap table administration

  • Work with Finance team on expense control and spend management (Brex), including SaaS spend increases and vendor admin

  • Own DocuSign for all official documents: routing, chasing signatures, and securely handling sensitive information

  • Partner with our infosec advisor on platform security, access management, and GDPR compliance

  • Liaise with our fractional General Counsel on legal matters as they arise

  • Be the first responder when things break, such as systems access issues, platform outages (e.g. HubSpot down), or urgent people matters, while staying calm and solving problems under pressure

  • Act as the go-to person ("oracle of truth") for managers and staff navigating people, process, or systems questions

  • Help plan company events and logistics: all-hands, team dinners, office space bookings, and department visits

What We're Looking For

We want someone early in their career who is highly organised, discreet, endlessly resourceful, and genuinely enjoys being the person who gets things sorted; someone with a strong work ethic who's willing to jump in when something urgent comes up, even outside standard hours.

Essential:

  • 1-2 years of experience in operations, people ops, HR, or a related generalist function (internships count)

  • Strong working knowledge of Google Suite (Sheets, Docs, Drive, Forms)

  • Excellent written communication and close attention to detail

  • Highly self-managing with a genuine self-starter mentality

  • Comfortable handling sensitive, confidential information with discretion

  • A calm, positive problem-solver who thrives when putting out fires

  • Strong people skills; able to navigate sensitive conversations (e.g. compensation, access, performance) with tact

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with HR/ops or fintech platforms such as Rippling, Carta, SeedLegals, Brex, DocuSign, or 1Password

  • Familiarity with UK employment/equity concepts (EMI schemes) or US equity structures (ISOs)

  • Experience in a fast-growing startup or AI company

  • Exposure to investor relations, cap table management, or working alongside legal/finance functions

What We Offer:

  • A pivotal role in a fast-growing AI startup with a unique product offering

  • Competitive compensation

  • Direct mentorship and exposure to founders and senior leadership

  • A collaborative, innovative, and supportive work culture

  • Opportunities for professional growth in the emerging field of AI solutions

  • Freedom and autonomy are our principal values

title: Senior Risk Manager
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Trading212
description_html:
Our mission is to enable everyone to build wealth.

We reinvent how trading and investing work by creating exceptional products people love. Fostering a culture of excellence and high velocity is the key to our success.

Over the past few years, our client base has grown 20 times to over 4 million, and client assets have grown over 50 times to over €5 billion.

Role Overview

The Senior Risk Manager will play a crucial role in supporting the business to embed the Risk Management Framework and manage and mitigate risks across the organisation. You will be responsible for liaising with the first line of defence to support them in identifying and understanding their risk profile, assessing the design and effectiveness of controls and procedures, ensuring these align with internal policies. This role requires a deep understanding of financial markets, trading practices, and global best practices for risk management frameworks.

What you’ll do

  • Ensure the organisation’s approach to the management of risk is aligned with its risk appetite and strategy.

  • Facilitate delivery and maintenance of Risk and Control Risk Assessments (RCSAs), ensuring appropriate oversight of risk identification, assessment and treatment are performed in line with risk appetite.

  • Perform periodic independent second line of defence assurance through the delivery of individual controls testing and thematic assurance reviews.

  • Identify gaps in the control environment and work with the first line of defence to determine remediation plans, ensuring progress is tracked and reported on through governance.

  • Deliver Top-Down Risk Assessments through engaging with senior management and subject matter experts to identify material risks the Firm are exposed to.

  • Maintenance of the legal entity Risk Register and overseeing the maintenance of thematic Risk Registers, including the Fraud Risk Register, Market Abuse Risk Register and Business Wide Financial Crime Risk Assessment.

  • Participating in the ICARA process, ensuring all relevant risks are captured, quantified and adequately stressed.

  • Providing oversight of risk events by working with first line colleagues to understand the root cause of events, their impact on the Firm and what corrective and preventive actions are required to remediate.

  • Demonstrating a solid understanding of liquidity risk management.

  • Delivering coherent, transparent and rigorous risk governance reporting.

  • Delivery of Risk projects to develop, evolve and enhance both the design and embeddedness of the Firm’s Risk Management Framework and supporting processes.

  • Provide an overview and challenge of the trading risk to which the firm is exposed.

  • Ensure appropriate horizon scanning processes are implemented to identify and manage emerging risks.

  • Providing second line risk reviews for new product and feature launches, and strategic and regulatory change initiatives, ensuring risk is identified from the offset, with downstream impacts managed and aligned to risk appetite.

  • Support the identification and enhancement of both qualitative and quantitative risk appetite measures, ensuring these are tracked with any breach escalated and remediated in line with risk appetite.

  • Preparing and presenting thematic risk reports and assessments to senior management and governance bodies.

  • Fostering a healthy Risk Culture by promoting the view that risk management is a universal responsibility by encouraging open and transparent discussions without fear of retaliation.

What you need to have

  • Extensive knowledge of risk management principles and practices.

  • Strong analytical and strategic thinking abilities.

  • High attention to detail and risk assessment skills.

  • Effective communication and leadership capabilities.

  • Understanding of the FCA’s MiFIDPRU framework, wind-down planning, and operational resilience

  • Financial management, particularly capital and liquidity management.

  • Management and understanding of market risk in a retail client base.

  • Ability to develop and implement risk mitigation strategies.

  • Proficiency in risk management software and tools.

  • Outsourcing/TPRM experience is good to have.

What we offer

  • Unique challenges that will help you grow and realise your potential really fast

  • Opportunity to make a big impact - you will create products used by millions of investors to build wealth

  • Work with smart, high-performing colleagues with a common goal in a flat, cross-functional team structure

  • An environment where nothing is set in stone, no bureaucracy

  • Appreciation for your talent and ideas

  • Generous remuneration package including annual bonuses

Bring your ambition to Europe’s fastest-growing mobile broker!

title: Technical Support Engineer (L2) - Compute
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Mistral.ai
description_html:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

Mistral AI is building a new Compute Support team to ensure the reliability, performance, and scalability of our GPU clusters in a Kubernetes environment. As one of the founding members of this team, you will play a pivotal role in shaping its processes, standards, and culture.

In this hybrid L1/L2 support role, you will be the first point of contact for customers and internal teams, providing technical guidance, troubleshooting, and issue resolution for compute-related inquiries. You’ll also serve as the escalation point for complex issues, leveraging your deep systems knowledge, Kubernetes expertise, and operational debugging skills to ensure our AI workloads run smoothly at scale.

This is a support-focused role that blends system administration, customer-facing communication, and compute infrastructure expertise. While coding is not the primary focus, familiarity with Go for debugging and automation is a plus.

 
 

Key Responsibilities

First Customer’s Point of Contact

  • Act as the first interlocutor for customers and internal teams, providing timely and effective responses to compute-related inquiries.

  • Triage and prioritize incoming requests, ensuring SLAs are met for acknowledgment, first response, and resolution.

  • Gather and analyze initial issue details (e.g., logs, error messages, system metrics) to diagnose problems efficiently.

  • Provide clear, actionable guidance to customers and internal users, including temporary workarounds where applicable.

 
 

Technical Support

  • Serve as the L2 escalation point for Linux, Kubernetes, and compute infrastructure issues, providing deep technical troubleshooting for:

    • GPU/TPU workloads (e.g., CUDA errors, memory leaks, job failures).

    • Kubernetes clusters (e.g., pod crashes, node failures, networking misconfigurations).

    • Bare metal and cloud environments (e.g., AWS EC2, GCP VMs, HPC clusters).

  • Diagnose and resolve performance bottlenecks, hardware failures, and resource contention in distributed systems.

  • Analyze system metrics, logs, and traces (e.g., dmesg, journalctl, nvidia-smi, Prometheus, Grafana) to identify root causes of issues.

  • Participate in on-call rotations to provide 24/7 support for critical compute systems

  • Nice to have: Optimize system configurations (e.g., kernel parameters, filesystem tuning, network settings) for high-performance computing (HPC) and AI workloads.

 
 

Kubernetes & Containerization

  • Debug Kubernetes clusters with a focus on:

    • Pod and node issues (e.g., CrashLoopBackOff, OOMKilled, ImagePullBackOff).

    • Networking and storage (e.g., CNI plugins, PersistentVolumes, StorageClasses).

    • Resource management (e.g., Requests/Limits, QOS classes, node affinity).

  • Troubleshoot container runtime issues (Docker, containerd) such as image pull failures, OCI compliance, or runtime errors.

  • Collaborate with SRE teams to understand and improve existing IaC (Terraform, Ansible) and Go-based tooling.

 
 

Documentation & Process Improvement

  • Create and maintain runbooks, playbooks, and internal documentation for common compute issues (e.g., GPU debugging, Kubernetes troubleshooting).

  • Contribute to post-mortems with actionable follow-ups to prevent recurring incidents.

  • Train internal teams on best practices for compute infrastructure and debugging.

  • Help define and refine support processes as a founding member of the new Compute Support team.

What We’re Looking For

Required Skills & Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in system administration, technical support, or infrastructure operations, with a strong focus on compute-heavy environments (bare metal, cloud, HPC, or virtualization).

  • Deep Linux/Unix expertise:

    • Debugging kernel-level issues (e.g., OOM killer, I/O bottlenecks, CPU throttling).

    • Performance tuning (e.g., sysctl, ulimit, filesystem optimizations).

    • Networking troubleshooting (e.g., iptables, tcpdump, DNS, NFS, SSH).

    • Storage management (e.g., LVM, RAID, NVMe, GPU-local storage).

  • Hands-on Kubernetes experience is mandatory:

    • Debugging pods, nodes, and clusters (e.g., kubectl describe, kubectl logs, crictl).

    • Networking and storage (e.g., CNI plugins, PersistentVolumes).

    • Resource management (e.g., Requests/Limits, QOS classes).

  • Familiarity with containerization (Docker, containerd) and basic IaC awareness Proficiency with monitoring tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, OpenTelemetry).

  • Basic scripting/automation skills (preferably Go, but Bash or Python are acceptable for ad-hoc tasks).

  • Experience with bare metal, virtualization, or HPC environments (e.g., Fluidstack, Coreweave, Vast) is a strong plus.

  • Excellent problem-solving and communication skills, with the ability to explain technical issues clearly and patiently to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Customer-focused mindset with a passion for resolving issues efficiently and improving system reliability.

  • Ability to work in on-call rotations and handle high-pressure situations with a structured, calm approach.

  • Commitment to meeting tight SLAs for issue acknowledgment, triage, and first response.

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

Privacy Policy

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy.

description_html:
Our client is an established architecture and design firm specialising in large-scale workplace projects across France and wider Europe. As the business enters its next phase of growth, they are seeking a Head of Design Operations to take operational ownership of the design function which includes leading a team of designers and technical staff, managing budgets and workload, and ensuring every concept and technical output meets the standard their international clients expect.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide hands-on operational leadership to design professionals and external freelance resources, across concept development and technical design phases.
  • Manage workload allocation, resourcing and scheduling so the team delivers reliably and to deadline.
  • Own budget oversight and cost control across the design function.
  • Review, challenge and quality-check technical plans and design outputs before they go to clients, ensuring they meet required technical, accessibility and regulatory standards.
  • Act as a key client-facing point of contact on design quality and delivery for international clients on large-scale workplace projects.
  • Strategically deploy freelance and external resources for technical or lower-value tasks to support the team's ability to scale.
  • Coach, mentor and develop a team of creative and technical professionals, building a stable, high-performing team culture.
  • Partner closely with the pre-construction and delivery teams to ensure a seamless handover of projects from concept through to completion.
  • Report to senior leadership on team performance, project status and resourcing needs.

 

Requirements

  • Significant experience in an operational leadership role within architecture, interior design, workplace fit-out or construction, gained in a design, delivery or technical management capacity.
  • Proven track record managing and developing teams of design or technical professionals, including workload planning and resourcing.
  • Demonstrated experience overseeing project budgets and cost control.
  • Strong technical literacy, with the ability to read, review and challenge technical and design plans, even without personally producing creative concepts.
  • Client-facing experience, with the ability to build trust with international clients.
  • Professional working proficiency in French.
  • Eligibility to work in France, or to obtain the relevant right to work.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Background as an architect, interior designer, or in a related technical/design discipline. Candidates from construction or similar technical backgrounds are also encouraged to apply; a design qualification is not essential.
  • Working knowledge of Revit.
  • Fluency in English is valuable given the team's exposure to international projects across Europe.
  • Experience developing creative concepts and pitching to clients (an advantage, not a requirement).
  • Experience in workplace design, fit-out, or large-scale commercial interior projects.

Benefits

  • Base salary: €75,000 to €90,000 gross per annum, commensurate with experience, with flexibility for an exceptional candidate.
  • Variable incentive: To be confirmed and discussed with shortlisted candidates.
  • Working pattern: Hybrid, 2 days of remote work per week.
  • Travel: Approximately 5% of time, across European project sites.
  • Leave: French statutory annual leave entitlement (minimum 25 working days). Any additional leave or benefits to be confirmed with shortlisted candidates.

Cabinet d'architecture et de design reconnu, spécialisé dans les grands projets d'aménagement d'espaces de travail en France et en Europe, recherche un Directeur ou une Directrice des Opérations Design pour piloter une équipe d'environ huit personnes : budgets, charge de travail et qualité technique. Poste opérationnel, pas de direction créative, avec une réelle autonomie et le soutien de la direction générale.

  • Superviser les budgets et le contrôle des coûts.
  • Contrôler la qualité des plans techniques avant transmission aux clients.
  • Être l'interlocuteur clé des clients internationaux sur la qualité et la livraison.
  • Rendre compte à la direction générale.

Qualifications Requises

description_html:
bunch is building the backbone of private markets. We are enabling next-gen fund operations with one integrated system that combines secure data infrastructure, AI-powered workflows and expert fund services. If you value ownership, growth through real responsibility, and working with a thoughtful, ambitious team, this role might be for you.


Your Role

We’re hiring a Sales Development Representative to own the front half of our sales funnel—but this isn’t a pure dial-for-dollars role. You’ll generate and qualify pipeline from fund managers across venture capital and private equity, while partnering hands-on with our Account Executives as deals move through the middle of the funnel.

You’ll help prepare specialised decks, tailor materials, and keep opportunities moving. This is a role for someone who wants full visibility into how a B2B sales cycle works, not just the first five minutes of it.

Top of funnel

  • Research and prioritise target accounts by assets under management, fund stage, vehicle type, and geography

  • Own and maintain signal sources such as new-fund announcements and regulator registers, including BaFin, the FCA, and the CSSF

  • Run outbound campaigns across email, LinkedIn, and calls to generate qualified conversations for accounts not already activated by Account Executives

  • Qualify inbound leads against our ideal customer profile and book meetings for Account Executives

  • Keep HubSpot pristine, with accurate stages, notes, and next steps for every touchpoint

  • Deliver against weekly and monthly activity and pipeline-generation targets

Mid funnel

  • Partner with Account Executives to prepare for deep dives and workshops by pulling together GP and fund research, competitive context, and meeting briefs

  • Build and tailor pitch decks, one-pagers, and proposal materials for specific prospects

  • Track deal status alongside Account Executives so opportunities do not stall for lack of a document, follow-up, or clear next step

About You

  • 1–3 years of experience in an SDR, BDR, or sales-support role, ideally in private markets, fintech, or financial services

  • Sales Navigator, HubSpot, and AI tools such as Claude, Granola, or equivalent are part of your daily workbench—not occasional aids

  • You can build repeatable systems to monitor signals across regulator registers and hundreds of accounts rather than working through them manually

  • Comfortable writing sharp outbound copy and building clean, persuasive decks in Google Slides

  • Strong organisational instincts—you keep details, documents, and next steps from falling through the cracks

  • Genuine curiosity about private markets and fund structures; prior exposure to venture capital, private equity, or fund administration is a strong plus, not a requirement

  • CRM fluency, with HubSpot preferred

  • Excellent written and verbal English

Nice to Have

  • Experience selling to fund managers, general partners, or asset managers

  • Familiarity with fund administration, compliance, or fund-operations concepts

Workplace & Benefits

  • Customisable benefits package covering wellbeing, sport, mobility, food, and more

  • 28 days of vacation, plus 2 company days and local public holidays

  • Up to 6 remote calendar weeks a year

  • A great tech and work setup

  • Work with a diverse team of 130+ bunchies from 40+ countries, with leaders who are best-in-class in their domains

Hiring Process

  1. People Team Interview (30 min) – Meet us, share what you’re looking for, and explore whether the role and bunch feel like the right mutual fit.

  2. Commercial Deep Dive (30 min) – Discuss your sales experience, how you create and qualify pipeline, and how you partner with AEs to move opportunities forward.

  3. Case Study with our Head of Sales (45 min) – Work through a practical, role-relevant scenario and show how you research accounts, prioritise opportunities, communicate clearly, and turn information into action.

Questions? Reach out to

Curious to learn more?

Get a feel for who we are, how we work, and what we’re building:

  • About bunch – Our mission, product, and journey so far

  • Case Studies – Meet the teams building on bunch

  • Gathering insights – Our latest bunch of blog posts

  • Glossary – Explore commonly used private-market terms

About bunch

bunch is building the operating infrastructure for the next generation of private markets. We combine AI-powered automation with deep regulatory expertise to replace fragmented spreadsheets and manual processes with one integrated platform across the fund lifecycle, purpose-built for private markets heading toward $32 trillion in Assets Under Management.

We've 4x our ARR in 2025, crossed 150 fund managers and 12,000 LPs on the platform, and just closed our $35M Series B in May 2026. We're looking for ambitious people who want real ownership of hard problems, and who care about building infrastructure that actually matters to the people using it.

title: Software Implementation Engineer
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Heidi
description_html:
We’re Heidi.

We're building the future of healthcare by giving every clinician the earth's finest AI Care Partner. In just 18 months, our clinical AI products have absorbed the administrative chaos of 73 million patient visits. Today, we support over 2.5 million patient sessions a week across 190+ countries.

Healthcare systems are failing us; clinicians spend more time on documentation than on patients, and the human connection that makes medicine worth practicing is eroding. Our mission is simple: double the world’s healthcare capacity and strengthen the human connection at its heart.

We found product-market fit with a freemium medical scribe that clinicians love. Now, we're expanding. Every task a clinician hands to Heidi is a patient who feels more attended to, a health system unclogged, and a clinician who gets to be a clinician again.

If you don’t choose easy and you want to build something way bigger than yourself, then choose the challenge, choose Heidi.

The role

 

The Software Implementation Engineer is a hands-on technical delivery role at the centre of complex NHS deployments. At Heidi, the CSM owns the customer from day one: the relationship, the rollout plan, the path to renewal. The Implementation Engineer is the technical arm they lean on: the person who personally configures SSO with the customer's IT team, sets up and provisions tenants, delivers EHR integrations through to go-live, configures agents and custom builds, and gives every technical problem a fast diagnosis and the right owner — fixing what is configuration, and handing confirmed product defects to Support Engineering, who own and drive their resolution.

You are the reason launches don't stall on technical topics. The remit is deliberately broad: anything to do with getting an account set up, configured and optimised is yours, from account configuration and MFA through to integration build and iteration, rather than being split across several specialist roles.

Clinical training and adoption sit with Clinical Enablement, not here. Your ownership begins upon acceptance of the enterprise handover. It ends when the agreed technical scope has passed its acceptance criteria, customer sign-off has been recorded, the final configuration has been documented and the implementation has transferred into hypercare or BAU support.

You are technically credible in front of a CIO, precise in what you hand to engineers, and relentless about closing the loop — and you translate what customers need technically into clear, prioritised asks for the Technical Program Manager (TPM), who owns the integration roadmap and prioritisation.

Success in this role looks like:

  • Hands-on delivery — you personally set up, configure and validate the technical footprint of an account: identity, provisioning, integrations, agents, data flows. Not coordinated — done.

  • Technical ownership — every technical problem at your accounts gets a fast diagnosis and a clear owner. What is configuration or implementation, you fix; what is a product defect, Support Engineering owns and drives — you hand it over with the diagnosis attached and do not shadow the ticket. CSMs never have to diagnose or route technical problems themselves.

  • Fast unblocking — technical blockers that would stall a launch for weeks get diagnosed, sequenced and resolved in days, because you understand the problem and know exactly who has to do what.

  • Clean boundaries — you hand net-new build work to FDEs as precise, prioritised requirements they can act on without rework, and you route live product defects to Support Engineering with a proper diagnosis attached — you don’t hoard work that belongs elsewhere, and you don’t toss problems over walls.

  • Trusted translation — customer IT and security teams treat you as a peer; the Technical Program Manager (TPM) gets integration gaps and technical priorities from you they can act on, and product hears a clear, prioritised signal.

This is a delivery-accountable role, so your job is to make the technical side of every account work: identity live, tenants configured, integrations delivered, agents built, security questions answered, and technical problems solved before they become escalations.

What you’ll do

Technical Onboarding & Account Setup

  • Own the technical setup of new enterprise accounts end to end: tenant and workspace configuration, user provisioning and seat structure, environment readiness.

  • Configure SSO with the customer’s IT team — SAML / OIDC against Okta, Microsoft Entra and NHS identity infrastructure — including MFA and conditional-access alignment.

  • Drive network and device readiness: whitelisting, VDI and shared-device constraints, mobile device management, so clinicians can actually use Heidi on day one. Work directly with customer IT to clear whatever is blocking a swift deployment: deployment questionnaires, IT vetting, access requests, environment prerequisites.

Integration Delivery

  • Receive the validated integration design and signed SOW from presales. Confirm implementation prerequisites, elaborate the agreed design where necessary, configure the Heidi components, perform technical testing, support customer UAT and execute the technical go-live activities within the implementation plan you own.

  • Translate the agreed SOW and technical design into precise, prioritised implementation requirements; hand net-new build to FDEs in a form they can act on without rework, own the account-side delivery around it, and surface integration gaps to the Technical Program Manager. Raise any requirement that is missing, materially different or genuinely out of scope through formal change control before work proceeds, rather than absorbing scope creep silently.

  • Provide credible estimates, identify dependencies early and give the CSM evidence-based status and recovery options. You own the integrated technical plan, customer-facing delivery dates and dependency escalation. After go-live, keep working with the trust integration team to iterate and optimise the integration: anything that is not a product defect is yours to make work.

Product-technical Configuration

  • Set up agentic workflows, agents and custom builds to fit each account’s clinical and operational workflows, turning vague customer asks into scoped configurations with clear acceptance criteria.

  • Translate what the customer bought into what has to be configured, and set it up: products, identity, integrations, agents, APIs, exports and data flows. As Heidi adds products (agents, agentic workflows, comms), their account-level setup lands here too.

  • Handle technical template and coding setup where it crosses into system behaviour (clinical content stays with Clinical Enablement).

Technical Escalation & Resolution

  • During active implementation and hypercare, be the first technical port of call for CSMs: when something technical breaks or will not configure, you provide first-line diagnosis and make sure it lands with the right owner. Once an account has formally handed over to BAU, Support Engineering owns initial triage and ongoing incident management, and you are re-engaged only through agreed escalation criteria.

  • Diagnose before you route: implementation-phase and account-specific configuration issues are yours to fix; confirmed product defects go to Support Engineering with your diagnosis attached — they own and drive resolution, and Support Engineering owns defect resolution. The Implementation Engineer remains informed where the defect affects implementation milestones, acceptance criteria or customer readiness, without duplicating Support’s investigation.

  • Translate customer technical problems into clear priorities — routing integration gaps to the Technical Program Manager (who owns the roadmap) and confirmed defects to Support Engineering — the alignment that gets problems actually solved.

Information Governance & Security Enablement

  • Provide accurate technical input and evidence for DPIAs, security questionnaires and IT-assurance requests, routed through Compliance, who owns these processes. Security, Privacy and Clinical Safety retain approval authority for their respective positions. Keep them off the critical path without becoming the sign-off owner.

  • Work within NHS governance gates — clinical safety sign-off, IG approval, change-control windows — planning technical work around them (clinical-safety substance is owned by Heidi’s Clinical Safety Officer).

Handover acceptance and scope control

  • Review the signed SOW, discovery notes, technical decision record, architecture, acceptance criteria, success measures and open risk log before technical implementation begins.

  • Return the handover where a blocking material risk, unclear scope or unsupported commitment prevents a credible implementation plan.

  • Deliver against the agreed scope without converting new customer requirements into configuration work.

  • Classify emerging requests as in-scope configuration, defect, net-new engineering, roadmap request or commercial change.

  • Escalate material scope changes through the CSM, SE and AE before committing work or dates.

 

How we show up

  • Build for the next decade, not next quarter. Our targets are outrageous on purpose. The world's health doesn't have the luxury of incrementalism.

  • Lead, don't wait. We treat tomorrow's problems today. Sometimes we build what's needed before it's wanted, and we're fine with that.

  • Follow the evidence. Trust the patient. We pursue truth relentlessly. But when the subjective and objective disagree, we treat the patient, not the numbers. Ego is a comorbidity we can't afford.

  • Own the outcome. Everyone here carries the company. Raise problems with solutions, solve them end-to-end, and never be a bystander.

  • Ship, measure, go again. A button today, a workflow tomorrow. More iterations beat better planning. We're precise at pace, not reckless.

  • Live in clinicians' reality. Not the ideal workflow, the twenty-patients-before-lunch actual one. We build for exhausted humans, and we'd better be decent ones while we do it.

 

Why Heidi?

You’ll join a team focused on real-world impact over imaginary valuations and glossy PR. We live and breathe the challenges of modern health systems, and are laser-focused on exacting the change we’d like to see. We’re medicos, engineers, builders, and designers who’ve felt the moral and practical toll of what non-care feels like. True A-players progress extremely fast here. The nature of the scale-up game is demanding, but we value sustainable performance and mental health. You're trusted to perform, and you set your schedule. We operate on outcomes > inputs, not process theatre. We all take the bins out, metaphorically and literally.

Building what we’re building isn’t always easy. But we didn’t choose easy, we chose to build something that actually matters. We hold ourselves to a higher standard because healthcare demands it. If you join Heidi, you recognise that the deeper question isn’t whether AI can solve the global healthcare crisis, but whose hands will shape it. The work is hard, but you will trust and admire the people you work beside, and rest easy knowing you’re doing the defining work of your career.

Our Benefits

  • Equity from day one. When Heidi wins, you win. You'll share directly in the success you help create.

  • Your health, covered. Comprehensive private medical and dental cover through Bupa, plus 24/7 mental health, coaching and wellbeing support through Sonder and a £100/month Healthy Heidi’s stipend.

  • Global parental leave. 26 weeks paid for primary carers and 18 weeks for secondary carers, subject to eligibility.

  • Fertility support. £7,000 one-off payment, eligibility applies.

  • Learning & development. £700 per year for courses, books, memberships, conferences and more.

  • Home office budget of £500 one-off to set up a workspace you actually want to work in.

  • Recharge days after major milestones and busy periods so you can reset and come back strong.

  • Work from anywhere for up to 4 weeks per year, wherever the world takes you.

  • Clinical leave. 10 days per year for eligible clinical roles to maintain accreditation and requirements.

  • Flexibility that works. A hybrid environment, with 3 days in the office.

Heidi’s commitment to Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

Heidi is dedicated to creating an equitable, inclusive, and supportive work environment that brings people together from diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. Our strength is in our differences. We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are proud to welcome all applicants as we're committed to promoting a culture of opportunity for all.

title: Product & Operations Management Apprentice
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Backmarket
description_html:
Hi, we’re Back Market.

We’re here to help make tech reliable, affordable, and better than new. We're a global marketplace for refurbished devices, helping lower our collective environmental impact by providing trustworthy, affordable tech with 92% less carbon emissions than new.

Yep, you read that right. Turns out refurbished tech is way better for the planet than new. In fact, With every device purchased on Back Market, our positive impact on the planet grows. From our Customer Care representatives to our software engineer, every individual at Back Market cuts the planet — and consumers — a break. Our mission is simple: to do more with what we already have.

Are you ready to join us?

JOB DESCRIPTION:

We are looking for a passionate and motivated Product & Ops Manager Apprentice to join our Telco team.

This apprenticeship offers a unique opportunity to contribute to the Telco team’s mission, which is to empower millions of customers across Europe and the US to make smarter, greener, and more affordable choices when buying devices and mobile plans, both online and in-store. We build seamless customer journeys and scalable operations to bring refurbished devices and connectivity together through partnerships with established telcos, responsibly and at great value.

YOUR MISSION (IF YOU ACCEPT IT): 🥇

As a Product & Ops Management Apprentice in our Telco track, you’ll manage an end-to-end mobile app project, with high exposure and business impact, allowing you to contribute across the full product lifecycle. You’ll partner daily with developers, product and operations managers, and cross-functional stakeholders to ship meaningful improvements to our customer experience and operational efficiency. This role is perfect for someone who’s organised, resourceful, and a clear communicator, excited to learn by doing and eager to make an impact.

  • Manage an end-to-end mobile app project, from discovery to launch, driving real business impact and collaborating with cross-functional teams.

  • Support product discovery for future features: review customer insights, user research, and analytics (Amplitude, Tableau, GSheet) to identify opportunities and pain points, contributing to problem framing, solution hypotheses, and prioritisation with the Telco PM.

  • Drive delivery with the squad: collaborate daily with developers on user stories, acceptance criteria, and scope, participate in team rituals (stand-ups, planning, refinements, retros), lead QA and release readiness.

  • Coordinate cross-functional launches: work closely with Operations, Care, Content, Marketing, Design, Engineering, and Finance to secure everything needed for go-live (support flows, content, training, legal/finance inputs), maintaining Confluence documentation to keep stakeholders aligned.

  • Monitor and iterate: track product performance and customer journey metrics, surface insights and propose optimizations and support experiment design and follow-up (A/B tests, funnel diagnostics)

  • Support operations: help manage day-to-day operational logistics for selected product lines in Telco (e.g. process updates, partner coordination, data monitoring, accounting), suggest and build process improvements that enhance reliability and speed.

  • TOOLS YOU'LL USE: ⚒️ : Jira, Confluence, Figma, Amplitude, Google Workspace, Slack, Zoom, Tableau, GSheet.

YOU ARE IN THE RIGHT PLACE IF: ⭐

  • You are 100% comfortable in spoken and written English and French, as we are an international team (MANDATORY)

  • You have an interest in product & project management and always put the user at the center of your thoughts

  • You’re curious and comfortable switching between big-picture thinking and detail execution

  • You take ownership, ask good questions, and follow through

  • You are organized, resourceful, and a clear, structured communicator

  • You’re comfortable with data: you can read funnels, interpret trends, and form hypotheses

  • Team spirit is essential for you: you enjoy collaborating with engineers, designers, operations, and customer-facing teams

  • Bonus: prior exposure to product management, e-commerce, telco, or marketplace operations

  • You are enrolled in a French school.

ABOUT THE APPRENTICESHIP ℹ️

  • Starting date: January 2027

  • Duration: Ideally for 12 months (24months to be discussed).

  • Location: Bordeaux, France

  • Contract: You must already be enrolled in a work-study program in a French school (contrat d'alternance / d'apprentissage)

RECRUITMENT PROCESS: 📅

  • Product Sense Interview with Hiring Manager

  • Team/Cultural fit interview with an Ops Manager and Engineering Manager

  • HR Interview with Campus Recruitment Manager

WHY SHOULD YOU JOIN US ? ✌🏼

At Back Market, we’re committed to hiring and supporting diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives — it’s one of the reasons we’re such a high-scoring certified B Corp company (93.2).

No matter your role and seniority level, you’ll enjoy impact-driven work with hands-on career development in an innovative, driven, and fast-paced environment — with benefits to match, like:

- A mission driven work environment where your day to day makes an impact on the planet. Seriously.

- Hybrid work environment, with 2 remote days a week and 1 remote work week per quarter, plus 3 flex days.

- Employee Resource Groups, including mentorship programs, comprehensive accessibility policies, and cultural competency training.

At Back Market, we strive to create a workplace that embodies the world we’re trying to change. We’ve embedded our diversity, equity, and inclusion principles into our DNA — from dedicated staff to employee resource groups to our company values.

We know that the perfect background for a role doesn’t mean the perfect fit — we encourage you to apply for a role even if you think you may not have all the qualifications.

If reasonable accommodations are needed for the interview process, please do not hesitate to discuss this with the Talent Acquisition Team.

description_html:
Le rôle :

Au sein du pôle Planning Stratégique de l’agence, nous recrutons un.e Assistant.e Planneur.euse Stratégique Junior en stage. 

Vous participerez à l’accompagnement des équipes Conseil de l’agence dans la formulation de leurs stratégies clients (participation/animation des brainstormings, contribution à l’élaboration des recommandations stratégiques, soutien stratégique des équipes conseils).


Vous participerez également à la détection des tendances social media et à leur partage avec les équipes Conseils (rédaction de notes de tendance, rédaction de blogposts sur le futur du social media, veille sectorielle et veille globale).

Requirements

Profil recherché :

  • Issu(e) d'une formation bac +3 à bac +5 (en cours de formation universitaire ou écoles de communication),
  • Passionné(e) par le monde du web, les médias sociaux et la stratégie des marques,
  • Vous êtes présent(e) sur les plateformes sociales : Instagram, Reedit, Twitch et autres,
  • Vous êtes doté(e) d’un excellent rédactionnel et d’une orthographe irréprochable, la maîtrise de l’anglais est un plus,
  • Vous possédez une capacité de synthèse, un sens de l’observation avéré, et une importante curiosité,
  • La culture générale est importante pour vous : classique ou Internet (nouveaux rituels, memes),
  • Vous êtes intéressé(e) par les évolutions sociétales et les shifts digitaux,
  • Vous êtes dynamique, rigoureux(se), curieux(se) et créatif(ve)
  • Vous maîtrisez Internet, le Pack Office (plus spécifiquement Excel et PowerPoint), et les outils informatiques en général.

Benefits

Avantages :

🏡 Une politique de télétravail flexible (6 jours par mois)

💸 Prime de cooptation allant jusqu’à 1 500€ selon profil

🥪 Carte Swile pour vos déjeuners à hauteur de 10€/ repas

🚲 Indemnité kilométrique vélo pour ceux qui ne prennent pas les transports en commun

🏢 Un environnement agile, dynamique et ouvert sur l’époque dans des bureaux en plein cœur de Paris (10e), Canal Saint-Martin

✨ Une véritable politique bien-être/RSE : petits-déjeuners, tri des déchets, congé menstruel, politique diversité & inclusion … + Avantages CSE : activités sportives, massages, …

🏖️ 5 jours de Congés Payés 


À propos de We Are Social :

We Are Social est une agence créative internationale, née de l’ère du web social. 

Avec 1100 personnes réparties dans 19 bureaux dans le monde, nous accompagnons les stratégies de nos clients à une époque où les médias sociaux façonnent la culture.

Nos idées sont nourries par les individus, les comportements sur le social media, le gaming, l’univers de l’entertainment, les cultures, les communautés… 

Nous mettons notre créativité et notre ambition au service de marques visionnaires, comme Google, YouTube, Netflix, Renault, BNP Paribas, Air France, Spotify, Orange, Ubisoft, ou encore LOUIS XIII.

We Are Social compte des bureaux à New York, Los Angeles, Toronto, Madrid, Londres, Paris, Milan, Munich, Berlin, Amsterdam, Dubaï, Singapour, Hong Kong, Pékin, Shanghai, Shenzhen, Tokyo, Jakarta et Sydney.

title: Strategic Partner Pre-Sales & Customer Success Manager
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Viva
description_html:
Pourquoi viva.com ?

Viva.com, est la première banque européenne à destination des entreprises à avoir révolutionné l'acceptation des paiements omnicanaux en proposant l'émission de cartes, des prêts et des comptes de dépôt aux entreprises dans toute l'Europe. Agréée par la Banque de Grèce, elle opère sous le régime européen FOS dans 29 pays de l'UE

Viva.com est pionnière dans la technologie "Tap on Any Device", qui permet d'accepter des paiements sur tout type d'appareil.

Aujourd'hui, Viva.com est un acteur principal dans la transition vers des solutions commerciales All-in-One, grâce à sa gamme complète de services financiers.

La société a créé un écosystème dynamique comprenant plus de 450 partenaires technologiques innovateurs dans le domaine des hardware et software, assurant une connexion directe à tous les systèmes de paiement locaux et alternatifs interpays. Cela renforce la proposition de valeur de Viva.com.

Viva.com a pour mission de fournir aux entreprises une plateforme axée sur la rentabilité afin d'intégrer les dernières technologies.

The Strategic Partner Pre-Sales & Customer Success Manager supports Global Enterprises, Global Partners, and Strategic Accounts across the customer lifecycle—from discovery and solution design to implementation, go-live, adoption, and account expansion.

The role works closely with Business Development Managers, Sales, Technical Solution Architects, Product, and Legal to deliver tailored, scalable solutions and build successful long-term customer relationships.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support strategic commercial opportunities through discovery, solution design, presentations, demos, proposals, and RFP/RFI responses.
  • Understand customer requirements and design end-to-end solutions covering integrations, reporting, reconciliation, and tailored business needs.
  • Supports the preparation of business cases, Business Impact Assessments, project roadmaps, and Statements of Work.
  • Manage implementations from onboarding through testing, pilot, and go-live, coordinating internal and customer stakeholders.
  • Ensure projects are delivered according to the agreed scope, timeline, quality standards, and dependencies.
  • coordinate post-go-live customer-success activities, driving adoption, retention, satisfaction, and time to value.
  • Identify and refer potential account-expansion opportunities
  • Coordinate and contribute to regular business reviews with performance insights and recommendations
  • Provide structured customer and market feedback to Product teams, supporting the development of new features and improvements.
  • Document project outcomes, lessons learned, and reusable best practices.

Requirements

  • At least 5 years of experience in pre-sales, solution consulting, customer success, implementation, or strategic account management.
  • Experience managing enterprise customers or strategic partners, preferably within payments, FinTech, banking, SaaS, or technology.
  • Strong understanding of APIs, system integrations, reporting, reconciliation, and technology-enabled solutions.
